content: {"praised":["Beautiful Irish countryside setting enhances emotional depth.","Strong acting performances, especially Meryl Streep and supporting cast.","Touching portrayal of family struggles and sisterly bonds.","Melancholy tone resonates with viewers, reflecting 1930s Ireland.","Themes of survival and cultural identity are compelling."],"criticized":["Slow pacing makes the film feel dragged.","Limited plot; little happens beyond sister bickering.","Meryl Streep’s performance perceived as dull and overacting.","Minimal dancing scenes disappoint expectations.","Predictable acting and slow storytelling reduce engagement."]}
